description: Two applied physics students at TU/e. For Planet X and SPHEREx we built Same Sky, Same Colour, a web tool that blinks SPHEREx images of one patch of sky taken months apart at the same infrared colour, so a change of colour cannot pass for a change in the sky. Python and astropy for the data, plain JavaScript for the site, a public check behind every claim. Join us if you know photometry, can test the site on a phone without being a physicist, or can tell a story in a 30-second video.
